Part 47800584 — POS BATTERY CABLE, Positive, Red, 1842mm L; catalog quantity 1, callout 7; applicable for production dates 20-Nov-2014 through 01-Apr-2018 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/batteries-accessories/battery-cables-connections/pos-battery-cable/p/47800584). This covers a 2016 machine by production date, subject to serial/PIN verification.

Part 48147258 — POS BATTERY CABLE, Positive, Red, 1842mm L; catalog quantity 1, callout 7; applicable from 02-Apr-2018 onward (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/batteries-accessories/battery-cables-connections/pos-battery-cable/p/48147258), so it is not the expected 2016 selection.
The catalog also displays 84605008 for production dates up to 30-Nov-2014 in the pre-2015 electrical assembly, but that occurrence was not inspected and is omitted from the finding.
Machine discovery is a dated, partial local snapshot; catalog identity is a candidate rather than user-confirmed fitment. Verify the machine serial/PIN before ordering.

query: Can you find a positive battery cable for my CASE 2016 SR210?
response_text:
For a **CASE SR210 built in 2016**, the best catalog match is:

- **Positive battery cable:** **47800584**
- **Description:** Red cable, approximately **1,842 mm** long
- **Catalog quantity:** 1
- **Listed production range:** **November 20, 2014–April 1, 2018**
- [Product page](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/batteries-accessories/battery-cables-connections/pos-battery-cable/p/47800584)
- [Engine electrical assembly—callout 7](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/electrical-systems/engine-electrical-4-jun-2015-newer/cn/0FEA970B-18C0-4909-9278-CAD4FC2BAB31/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549)

A later alternative, **48147258**, is listed for machines built **April 2, 2018 and newer**, so it is not the primary match for a 2016 machine: [product page](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/batteries-accessories/battery-cables-connections/pos-battery-cable/p/48147258).

*This is based on the CNH US catalog, and the catalog’s assembly verification coverage is incomplete. Confirm the machine PIN/serial and production date before ordering; the 2016 model year alone does not prove exact fitment.*

The part is verified in assembly 55.101.AC[03] – WIRE HARNESS & CONNECTOR, ELECTRONIC CONTROLS (04-JUN-2016 & NEWER).

query: 2016 CASE SR210: I need a wiring-harness retention bracket.
response_text:
The likely bracket is **CASE part 47846376 — BRACKET, Harness Retention**, quantity 1.

It is cataloged for the 2016 SR210 in both harness configurations:

- **Electronic controls:** callout 18, for machines dated **04-Jun-2016 and newer** — [assembly listing](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/electrical-systems/wire-harness-connector-electronic-controls-04-jun-2016-newer/cn/5EC33628-1A80-457B-99B5-6D13B00EC0C3/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549)
- **Mechanical controls:** callout 19, for machines dated **04-Jun-2015 and newer** — [assembly listing](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/electrical-systems/wire-harness-connector-mechanical-controls-04-jun-2015-newer/cn/0DF739AD-583D-485C-B4DD-DD86A2B6F4CF/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549)

Product page: [47846376](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/chassis-frame/frame-structural/bracket/p/47846376)

*US CNH catalog evidence; the exact control configuration and serial/PIN fitment should be confirmed before ordering.

handoffs.part_query: 360-bar relief valve for the mechanically controlled 46 cc tandem hydrostatic pump

key_facts: Candidate catalog: SR210 - SKID STEER LOADER - TIER 4B (10/13 - 01/20), matching the supplied 2016 CASE SR210; discovery is from a dated partial index and fitment remains subject to serial/PIN verification.

Requested 360-bar relief valve for the 46CC tandem hydrostatic pump with mechanical control: part number 105720A1, description “VALVE PRESSURE RELIE,” catalog quantity 2. Verified in assembly 29.218.AC[01] – TANDEM HYDROSTATIC PUMP, 46CC, MECHANICAL CONTROL, FRONT; note: “Relief, 360 Bar, Incl 13 - 14” (callout 12).

The same part number 105720A1 is also verified in assembly 29.218.AC[02] – TANDEM HYDROSTATIC PUMP, 46CC, MECHANICAL CONTROL, REAR; catalog quantity 2, note: “Relief, 360 Bar, Incl 24, 30” (callout 12).
The 360-bar valve includes the noted associated callouts in each assembly; this is an inclusion note, not evidence that the valve is a complete pump assembly. Catalog quantity is not stock.
The inspected source does not establish complete assembly coverage; confirm the machine serial/PIN and front/rear pump position before ordering.

query: Can you find a 360-bar relief valve for the mechanically controlled 46 cc tandem hydrostatic pump for my CASE 2016 SR210?
response_text:
For your **2016 CASE SR210**, the catalog identifies **part 105720A1** as the **360-bar pressure relief valve** used in the **46 cc mechanically controlled tandem hydrostatic pump**.

- **Part:** 105720A1 — pressure relief valve, 360 bar  
- **Quantity:** Typically **2 per tandem-pump assembly** in the inspected front/rear assemblies  
- It is listed separately from the charge-relief valve and from electronically controlled pump relief components.
- Assembly references: [front tandem pump](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/hydrostatic-drive/tandem-hydrostatic-pump-46cc-mechanical-control-front/cn/8D4F56D7-722F-4746-B79C-49B4E53889B6/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549), [rear tandem pump](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/hydrostatic-drive/tandem-hydrostatic-pump-46cc-mechanical-control-rear/cn/914D04E0-9358-4FF4-917E-D105A5D46BE0/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549), [46 cc mechanical-control assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/hydrostatic-drive/hydrostatic-pump-46cc-mechanical-control-front/cn/0B95C731-C300-4E10-B2B8-90DD45BC0642/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549), and [rear 46 cc mechanical-control assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/hydrostatic-drive/hydrostatic-pump-46cc-mechanical-control-rear/cn/33E93D99-5C10-4FD4-AF2B-02897ADA252B/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549).
- Product/catalog reference: [105720A1](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/hydraulics/valves/valve-pressure-relie/p/105720A1)

*US CASE catalog evidence is from a partial dated index, so exact serial/PIN applicability and current stock should be confirmed before ordering. Note that the catalog quantity is not live inventory.*
